motivation: Two preregistered head-only training studies do not correct the large uncertainty-interpretation development failure. Adapt contextual attention rather than continue fitting scores to the same frozen representation.
training: All original verified TRAIN entries plus the 2561 screened semantic-training-12 prefixes. No regression, calibration or test labels enter training.
initialization: Released v9 language-specific adapter and both heads; retain unchanged epoch-zero release as a candidate.
trainable: Final 18 shared-KV layers, q/o rank-8 LoRA only, plus the active language head. Frozen embeddings, first 24 layers, KV sources and other-language head.
objective: Binary CE plus three times mean class-weighted six-field CE plus 0.2 mean seven-distribution KL to frozen v9 logits. Inverse-square-root field class weights capped at four and normalized on TRAIN. Equal total old/new by binary-label training mass. Teacher logits and targets are training-only.
execution: Single-example attention backward calls within joint minibatches, preserving the v9 Metal gradient workaround. Five-percent learning-rate warmup and linear decay to 10 percent. Frozen-body new-input states must replay the original feature extraction within 1e-5 before training.
selection: Original development only at epoch zero, half epoch and one epoch. Minimize binary errors, then joint argmax errors, then mean field cross-entropy, then maximize score margin. Select binary/policy/coupled-policy mode and threshold on development for trained checkpoints; epoch zero retains the actual released mode and threshold.
evaluation: Any selected attention change requires new neural regression inference; the old final-hidden-state cache cannot be reused. Preserve all failed checkpoints and report zero-regression failures.
